title: In order not to aggravate people of other religions, there was no Christmas tree in Brussels
text: EUvsDisinfo – przypadek dezinformacji: In order not to aggravate people of other religions, there was no Christmas tree in Brussels. SUMMARY Last year there was no Christmas tree in the centre of Brussels – a trait of a Christian holiday- in order not to disturb people of other religious confessions than Christian. RESPONSE
